items.title: Hackers Can Inject Malicious Code into Antivirus Processes to Create a Backdoor
items.description: A new technique enables attackers to exploit antivirus software by injecting harmful code directly into the antivirus processes. This approach makes it easier for them to evade detection and compromise the security that antivirus software is designed to provide.
